description: MauForma page-level density starting points. Not automatic aesthetic scores or universal pixel rules. Content-first, user preference overrides defaults.

sources.name: Carbon spacing
sources.applies: Use space to encode grouping/hierarchy rather than blank percentage quotas

sources.name: Carbon productive vs expressive
sources.applies: Data tasks can be denser; expressive or editorial contexts may be more spacious

sources.name: Nielsen Norman progressive disclosure
sources.applies: Keep frequent task controls visible; defer secondary information with discoverable access

sources.name: GitLab Pajamas progressive disclosure
sources.applies: Reduce visible complexity without losing function

sources.name: Atlassian compact density
sources.applies: Page-level density can be adjustable for detail work

profiles.label: 舒展 / Focused
profiles.spacing_strategy: Generous between distinct task sections; cohesive inside functional groups
profiles.surface_strategy: Prefer unboxed sections; use a surface only for a genuinely separate object/action or status
profiles.content_strategy: One clear primary task; secondary details via discernible links or contextual help
profiles.typography_strategy: Readable role sizes, do not shrink essential information
profiles.exceptions: Does not mean giant min-height or hiding required warnings

profiles.label: 均衡 / Everyday
profiles.spacing_strategy: Consistent group spacing with moderate separation, responsive to content length
profiles.surface_strategy: Cards for meaningful groups, not every sentence
profiles.content_strategy: Expose key context and one primary flow, details in next-level pages
profiles.typography_strategy: Keep hierarchy legible at desktop and mobile
profiles.exceptions: Can include multiple major groups when task requires them

profiles.label: 高效 / Data
profiles.spacing_strategy: Tighter within data groups and filters; still separate independent tasks
profiles.surface_strategy: Charts/tables may need containers, avoid nested wrappers
profiles.content_strategy: Show connected metrics, filters, main evidence and necessary status
profiles.typography_strategy: Protect chart labels, legends, sample sizes and interactive controls
profiles.exceptions: Density cannot hide failure, provenance or critical insight

profiles.label: 紧凑 / Expert
profiles.spacing_strategy: Reduce repeated labels and affordances while preserving click/keyboard accessibility
profiles.surface_strategy: Structured rows, panes, tables and grids rather than many independent cards
profiles.content_strategy: Make many task-relevant details scannable; allow switching back to easier mode when needed
profiles.typography_strategy: No blanket 10px labels; adapt structure before reducing text size
profiles.exceptions: Use when justified by expert workflow or user choice, not on every page
